id: title:Piccirello:narrow the ml mirror image lane to png jpeg gif and webp

review.posthog_relevance: Removes AVIF support from ingestion and transport, removing the ability to ingest AVIF images.
review.reason: The observed hunk P1.F10.H3 explicitly removes the case statement for 'image/avif' and associated transport/ingestion support. This is a substantive, bounded change to the ingestion and transport capabilities. It removes a specific image format support rather than adding a broader capability or fixing a systemic risk. This warrants a score of 1.
review.uncertainty: The tier is assigned based solely on the removal of AVIF support. No broader systemic benefit or wider adoption context is demonstrated in this chunk. The score does not account for potential downstream dependencies or the reason for removal, which could affect the actual value or risk profile.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single conservative group. No tier assignment is made; the score is not assigned. No tier assignment is made; the score is not assigned.

observations.behavior: Removes AVIF from the documented supported image types and removes the AVIF-specific image transport and ingestion support.
